events.title: AXA reports 6% rise in Q1 premiums and revenues in “volatile environment”
events.body: For the three months ended 31 March 2026, P&C premiums rose by 4% to €21.46bn ($25.26bn).

events.title: AXA posts 6% revenue growth in Q1, sees full-year EPS at upper end of range
events.body: Investing.com -- French insurer AXA reported a strong start to 2026, with gross written premiums and other revenues rising 6% year-on-year to €38.0 billion in the first quarter, driven by broad-based growth across its property and casualty

events.title: Gains in core segments propel 2025 earnings growth for AXA
events.body: The company’s total GWP and other revenues climbed 6% to €116bn ($137.07bn).

events.title: AXA DCP partners with Planet Labs for near-real-time disaster monitoring
events.body: Under the agreement, AXA DCP will incorporate data from Planet’s high and medium-resolution satellites, along with its frequently updated Basemaps, into an AI-driven risk management system.
